matter_background.original: In 1980 February Dayani Perera had purchased a land in extent of 15 perches situated in Kadawatha for Rs. 400,000/- and constructed a house on it. The cost of construction of the house was Rs. 3,100,000/-. She wishes to gift this house and land to her son Saranga and she instructs you to prepare a Deed of Gift. The present market value of the house and property is Rs. 5,400,000/-.
